responsibility: This header declares gcc::pass_manager, the object that owns GCC’s optimization pass pipeline and pass registry. It defines the canonical pass-list roots, storage for all instantiated pass objects and pass IDs, plugin registration hooks, dump-file registration, name lookup, and selected accessors for particular passes or pass groups such as early local passes, rest_of_compilation, and clean_state. It is the central management interface for constructing, indexing, and invoking the compiler’s pass tree.
